subject: Young girl in Lianport
text: The young girl in Lianport is rescued in a battle against two gremlins in the top-left of town.

evidence.quote: After jumping off the tower in the last achievement, just head north until you come across Lianport. Enter the town, head to the top-left, and save the young girl in a battle against two gremlins.

subject: Ship
text: Rescuing the girl gives you the ship, which opens the world.

evidence.quote: You will receive the ship after having rescued the girl, and the world is now open to you.

subject: Sunken treasures
text: After getting the ship, sail north to a whitish graphic in the sea and dive one square south of it to find the sunken treasures.

evidence.quote: once you get the ship, just keep going north without deviating. You'll eventually come across a whiteish graphic that stands our from the rest of the sea. Dive in the water one square south of it to find the treasures.

subject: Echoing Flute
text: The Echoing Flute is received from a man in a house in Lianport after finding the sunken treasures.

evidence.quote: Then go back to Lianport (directly south) and talk to the man inside the house behind a silver key door, who will give you the echoing flute.

subject: Golden Key
text: The Golden Key is found in Zahan.

evidence.quote: Getting the Golden Key next is recommended as it will open up a big part of the world. This one can be found in Zahan which, if you are comfortable following my directions, is slightly north-west of the buried treasure you found in the achievement before this one.

subject: Golden Key
object: dog who walks to a tree
text: In Zahan, the Golden Key is searched for where a dog stops after walking away to a tree.

evidence.quote: In this town, you will find a dog who you can interact with, who will walk away to a tree. Where the dog stops is where you want to search for the Golden Key (or somewhere around there, I'm not 100% sure if the dog always ends up at the exact same position).

subject: Shrine of Fire
text: The Shrine of Fire is on an island reached by sailing north-west from Zahan.

evidence.quote: From Zahan, sail north-west until you come across an island with a shrine called the Shrine of Fire.

subject: Shrine of Fire
text: The Shrine of Fire has three teleporters that can be ignored.

evidence.quote: This shrine has three teleporters that can be ignored.

subject: Sun Crest
text: The Sun Crest is on the floor of a corner in the Shrine of Fire, reached by walking out the right entrance, three squares up, and one square left.

evidence.quote: Instead, walk one square out of the entrance on the right, then three squares up, and one square left so that you end up in the corner. Search the floor here to find the Sun Crest.

subject: Sun Crest
text: The Sun Crest requires nothing to obtain and is near Zahan.

evidence.quote: While not immediately relevant, the Sun Crest is nearby Zahan and doesn't require anything to be obtained so you might as well get it out of the way now.

subject: Jailor's Key
text: The Jailor's Key is sold in the tool shop in Wellgarth's underground city by selecting an empty-looking line.

evidence.quote: Here, head to the tool shop and browse the store, and notice a suspiciously empty line with no text. ... As you might have guessed, select this line to gain the option to buy the Jailor's Key.

subject: Jailor's Key
text: Buying the Jailor's Key needs 2000 gold, and the guide suggests having the Golden Key first.

evidence.quote: If you have the Golden Key and 2000 gold, going for the Jailor's Key next is not a bad idea.

subject: Wellgarth
text: Wellgarth's Golden Key house leads by stairs down to an underground city.

evidence.quote: Once inside, you'll only see a house locked with a Golden Key, but once you take the stairs, you'll end up in an underground city.

subject: Floodgate Key
text: Roger Fastfinger in the empty-looking jail at the top-right of Wellgarth gives the stolen Floodgate Key.

evidence.quote: If you head to the top-right part of town, you'll come across a jail that looks empty. Enter the jail with the Jailor's Key, then go inside and hug the north wall to go outside. Talk to Roger Fastfinger here and he will give you the stolen Floodgate Key.

subject: Wellgarth jail
text: Entering the empty-looking jail in Wellgarth requires the Jailor's Key, and hugging the north wall leads outside.

evidence.quote: Enter the jail with the Jailor's Key, then go inside and hug the north wall to go outside.

subject: Moon Crest
text: The Moon Crest is in Osterfair castle on an island north of the Shrine of Fire and south of Midenhall Castle.

evidence.quote: First up is the Moon Crest, which is found in the castle of Osterfair. This is located on an island north of the Shrine of Fire, and south of Midenhall Castle.

subject: Moon Crest
object: talk to the King and fight his pet
text: To get the Moon Crest, talk to the King of Osterfair and fight his pet, and the crest is given.

evidence.quote: Obtaining this crest is quite easy: talk to the King, fight his pet, and the crest is yours.

subject: Water Crest
text: The Water Crest is in the top-right corner of Hamlin's underground jail and needs the Jailor's Key.

evidence.quote: The Water Crest needs the Jailor's Key, and is located in Hamlin (where you originally found the princess of Moonbrooke). There is an underground area here with a jail, so open it and prepare for a fight against gremlins. Once they are defeated, search the top-right corner of the jail and find the Water Crest.

subject: Star Crest
text: The Star Crest is in the lighthouse on an island west of Moonbrooke Castle.

evidence.quote: The Star Crest is located in the lighthouse, which is located on an island west of Moonbrooke Castle.

subject: Star Crest
text: The Star Crest is given after following the old man downstairs to a dead-end chest and winning the trap battle.

evidence.quote: This is another pretty large tower, and you want to climb all the way to the top there to find an old man. This old man will then head downstairs again, so follow him until you get to a dead end with a chest. This is a trap which will lead into a battle, so take care of it and receive the Star Crest as a reward.

subject: Lighthouse
text: On the bottom floor of the lighthouse, take the bottom-left stairs, the only ones leading toward the goal rather than to unneeded chests.

evidence.quote: The tower has so many stairs that it becomes somewhat tough to detail the correct path to take upstairs, apologies for that. Regardless, on the bottom floor you want to take the bottom-left stairs, as these are the only ones that will bring you to your goal rather than to chests you won't really need at this point in the game.

subject: Tuhn
object: coastline west of Wellgarth or east from Osterfair
text: Tuhn can be reached by sailing along the coastline west of Wellgarth or going east from Osterfair.

evidence.quote: I can't really explain well how to find Tuhn, so preferably look at the world map I included. If not, then you can reach it by either sailing across the coastline west of Wellgarth, or going east from Osterfair.

subject: Tuhn
text: Taking the left-most river inland and following the land path leads to Tuhn.

evidence.quote: Take the left-most river going inlands, and travel towards the end after which you are forced to continue your path on land. Follow this path, and you'll end up in Tuhn.

subject: Tuhn floodgate
text: The Tuhn floodgate is opened with the Floodgate Key at a Jailor's Key door north of the village.

evidence.quote: In Tuhn, you want to head north of the village until you see a Jailor's Key door. Go down here, and then use the Floodgate Key you got earlier to open up the floodgate.

subject: Moon Fragment
text: The Moon Fragment is in the tower south of Tuhn, which can be accessed after the floodgate is opened.

evidence.quote: After the floodgate has been opened, you can access the tower south of Tuhn.

subject: Tuhn tower
text: In the tower south of Tuhn, take the south stairs on the bottom floor, the middle stairs above, then two more stairs up to a doored floor, open the doors, and take the stairs down to the Moon Fragment.

evidence.quote: Finding the Moon Fragment here is pretty straighforward: take the stairs south on the bottom floor, then the middle stairs on the floor above, and keep going up two more stairs until you reach a floor with doors. Open the doors, take the stairs down, and you'll eventually end up at the Moon Fragment.

subject: Malroth's Cavern
text: Malroth's Cavern opens when the Moon Fragment is used in front of a small island in the sea south-west of Osterfair Castle.

evidence.quote: Once you have the Moon Fragment, now it's time to find Malroth's Cavern. This is a small island in the middle of the sea so have fun finding it without my included map, but it's generally south-west of Osterfair Castle so you'll find it there. Use the Moon Fragment in front of the small island and the path will open to Malroth's Cavern.

subject: Eye of Malroth
text: The Eye of Malroth is found in Malroth's Cavern.

evidence.quote: The Eye of Malroth is, unsurprisingly, found in the now-open Malroth's Cavern.

subject: Malroth's Cavern
text: Malroth's Cavern main-path route: floor 1 go south-west to stairs; floor 2 go north-west past a lava path to stairs; floor 3 open the door, cross the big stairs room, and take the left stairs on the second row from the top; floor 4 cross lava to the west side and take the single stairs; floor 5 continue onward to the Eye of Malroth.

evidence.quote: **Floor 1** - Go south-west until you reach stairs. ... **Floor 2** - Go to the north-west, where you will find stairs that is behind a small path of lava. ... **Floor 3** - Open the door here and proceed further until you find a big room with many stairs. It generally does not matter too much which stairs you take as they will all bring you to the next floor, but if you want to be closest to the floor after, then take the left stairs on the second row from the top. ... **Floor 4** - Go to the west side of the floor here across lava. You will find a single set of stairs. ... **Floor 5** - Just continue onwards here and you'll find the Eye of Malroth.

subject: Beran
object: south-east of Osterfair and north-east of Zahan
text: Beran is south-east of Osterfair and north-east of Zahan.

evidence.quote: After you have both the Eye of Malroth and the Jailor's Key, head to the town of Beran. This is located south-east of Osterfair, and north-east of Zahan.

subject: Rhone Plateau cave
text: The cave to Rhone Plateau opens when the Eye of Malroth is used in a swamp reached by a Jailor's Key-locked teleporter in Beran.

evidence.quote: In this town, you will find a teleporter behind a Jailor's Key door, which will bring you to a small area with a swamp on the left side. Enter this swamp and use the Eye of Malroth to open the cave to Rhone Plateau.

subject: Heart Crest
text: The Heart Crest is in a chest in Rhone Cave, reached by taking the stairs to the right of the entrance and heading right.

evidence.quote: You'll find the Heart Crest very quickly after entering the Rhone Cave. Simply take the stairs to the right of the entrance, then head right here to find a chest with the Heart Crest.

subject: Lightning Sword
text: The Lightning Sword is found in Rhone Cave.

evidence.quote: Oh boy, Rhone Cave. This dungeon does have a lot of items and it is absolutely highly recommended to get pretty much all of them, including the Lightning Sword and Erdrick's Armor that somehow ended up here.

subject: Erdrick's Armor
text: Erdrick's Armor is found in Rhone Cave.

evidence.quote: Oh boy, Rhone Cave. This dungeon does have a lot of items and it is absolutely highly recommended to get pretty much all of them, including the Lightning Sword and Erdrick's Armor that somehow ended up here.

subject: Rhone Cave
text: A map of the Rhone Cave is linked at mikesrpgcenter.com.

evidence.quote: I'm going to be somewhat lazy and hand you this map (http://mikesrpgcenter.com/dw2/maps/cavetorhone.html), but if you still want to follow the path that heads straight to the exit, then use the following:

subject: Rhone Cave
text: Rhone Cave route to the exit: floor 1 take either of the two stairs going up on the right; floor 2 go right past two up-and-down paths and take the third for stairs; floor 3 take the north-eastern corner stairs then the next stairs; floor 4 go south past hidden holes, two tiles left, south to the wall, then right and up the stairs; floor 5 go right until the up-or-down option, then go up, take the left path, then right at the end.

evidence.quote: **Floor 1** - On the right side of the floor are two stairs going up. You can take either. ... **Floor 2** - Go right until you have passed two paths going up- and down. Take the third one for stairs. ... **Floor 3** - Take the stairs in the north-eastern corner of the floor (go north from where you start). Take the stairs you see right after this one as well. ... **Floor 4** - The stairs are south of where you are, but be wary of holes in the floor you cannot see. From the strais, go south until you bump in the wall, then go two tiles left, then go south until you hit another wall, then go right and up the stairs. ... **Floor 5** - This is a maze-like floor, but there is only one exit (which is also the exit of the cave). Your general goal is to make it to the right side of the floor until you get the option to go up or down. Here, go up, then take the left path, then right at the end and you're there.

subject: Charm of Rubiss
text: Once all five crests are collected, the Charm of Rubiss is received at the Shrine of Rubiss.

evidence.quote: Once you have all five crests, you need to go to the Shrine of Rubiss. This is a one-tile island in the sea so yet again, look at the map or alternatively, go north from the entrance to the island with Osterfair and you'll also get there. Head down all the way here and stand in the middle, after which Rubiss will hand you the Charm of Rubiss.

subject: Shrine of Rubiss
object: north from the entrance to the island with Osterfair
text: The Shrine of Rubiss can be reached by going north from the entrance to the island with Osterfair.

evidence.quote: This is a one-tile island in the sea so yet again, look at the map or alternatively, go north from the entrance to the island with Osterfair and you'll also get there.

subject: Hargon
text: Hargon is fought in Hargon's Castle, back-to-back with Malroth.

evidence.quote: You'll be facing Hargon and Malroth back-to-back in Hargon's Castle, and with this being the final dungeon, make sure you are geared up and a high level.

subject: Hargon's Castle bosses
text: The guide recommends getting close to level 40 before the Hargon and Malroth fights.

evidence.quote: There used to be an achievement for getting to level 40, and while it's not necessary anymore, I still would recommend getting close to it because they are tough boss fights.

subject: Shield of Strength
text: Carrying multiple unequipped Shields of Strength is recommended, since each works as a free HealMore in battle.

evidence.quote: Multiple Shield of Strengths (unequipped) are recommended, as they function as a free HealMore when used in battle.

subject: Hero strength exploit
text: Lower-level players may use an exploit that increases the hero's strength with no drawbacks.

evidence.quote: You may also want to use the exploit regarding increased strength with no drawbacks for the hero if you are a lower level.

subject: Hargon's Castle illusion
text: In Hargon's Castle, the illusion is dispelled with the Charm of Rubiss, and the path behind the throne leads to Hargon.

evidence.quote: When at Hargon's Castle, use the Charm of Rubiss to dispel the illusion. Then follow the path behind the throne until you end up at Hargon.

subject: Hargon
text: Against Hargon, the Hero keeps attacking while the Princess casts healing spells every turn.

evidence.quote: For Hargon, just keep attacking him with the Hero, while the Princess casts healing spells every turn.

subject: Hargon
text: The Prince of Cannock can heal, buff, debuff, or deal damage as needed each turn in the Hargon fight.

evidence.quote: The Prince of Cannock can do whatever is necessary for that turn, be it healing, buffing/debuffing, or just doing damage.

subject: Hargon
text: Hargon attacks twice per turn.

evidence.quote: Keep in mind that Hargon attacks twice per turn, so definitely be prepared for that if your HP is low.

subject: Malroth
text: Malroth attacks once per turn.

evidence.quote: Malroth follows up right after Hargon and is even tougher, but fortunately only attacks once per turn.

subject: Malroth
object: Hero attacks, Princess heals, Prince of Cannock support
text: The Malroth fight follows the Hargon strategy: the Hero attacks, the Princess heals, and the Prince of Cannock does what is needed.

evidence.quote: The same strategy applies: the Hero attacks, the Princess heals, and the Prince of Cannock does whatever is necessary at that point in time.

subject: Malroth
text: In the final boss fight, use all your MP on healing if needed.

evidence.quote: Do not be afraid to use all your MP on healing if necessary, as this truly is the final boss so you should throw everything you have at him.

subject: Refuse the king's offer
text: After the final bosses are defeated, talk to your father in Midenhall Castle and say no when he asks you to become king.

evidence.quote: After the big baddies are dealt with, head back to Midenhall Castle and talk to your father. Once he asks you to become king, just say no, after which he rejects your no so you will get the chance to say yes right after.

subject: Thou Hast Found Peace
text: The Thou Hast Found Peace achievement triggers after the conversation with the father.

evidence.quote: This will trigger after the conversation with your father.
